name: Arabic voice (ours)
reference: reference.wav -- a synthetic voice designed with VoxCPM2 (openbmb/VoxCPM2, Apache-2.0) from the description: 'A middle-aged Arab man with a warm, deep, natural voice, speaking calmly at a relaxed pace'. No real person's voice.
chosen: 2026-10-12 blind test, round 3: 4.50 / 5 (Meta 3.00); word error 2.9% (1.5% best of 2 takes) on the 6 shared Arabic sentences
speed: Chatterbox has no speed setting; varying cfg_weight did not change pace reliably, so the app speed menu does not apply to this voice.
